bio: Maria died on 23 January 1845, aged 58 (born about 1787), and was buried the next day as the wife of Vincenzo Ferlaino ([R4-S1], [R4-S2]). Both records name her parents as Andrea Colosimo and Carmela Cicco, who are new to the tree. Her 1809 marriage also names her father Andrea ([R4-S3]).
